additional time and mileage charges over one day. Coupon cannot be used for one-way rentals. One
coupon per rental. Offer may not be used in conjunction with any other coupon, promotion or offer.

other blackout periods may apply. If a rental begins during a blackout period, the whole rental is
blacked out and doesn't qualify for use of coupon. An advance reservation is required. Customer must
provide profile number associated with the coupon. Reservation must be cancelled by rental date, or

availabe on some rates at some times. For reservations made on Budget.com, free day will be applied

coupons. Budget reserves the right to refuse or expire coupons at any time without prior

At Alphabet, we combine innovative solutions with personal consulting to make mobility easy. Backed
by BMW expertise and offering multi-brand vehicle options, we simplify complexity and turn data into
clear decisions. Your mobility. Made easy.

 

What sets us apart: tailored leasing solutions that adapt to your specific business needs,
innovative tools and a strong commitment to sustainability, and seamless support helping you
navigate every step with confidence.

## Our core business

# Your mobility. Made easy.

At Alphabet, we specialise in fleet leasing and management. Through personal consulting &
innovation, we help you optimise your fleet and accelerate business performance.

[Get to know us][40]

 

Innovation

## What differentiates us

At Alphabet, we combine innovative solutions with personal consulting to make mobility easy. Backed
by BMW expertise and offering multi-brand vehicle options, we simplify complexity and turn data into
clear decisions. Your mobility. Made easy.

 

What sets us apart: tailored leasing solutions that adapt to your specific business needs,
innovative tools and a strong commitment to sustainability, and seamless support helping you
navigate every step with confidence.
1. ### Alphabet Connected Fleet
   
   Integrated into the 360 Fleet Portal via single sign-on, it includes real-time data into
   exclusive tools such as AI-driven Fleet Reporting and sharpens your ESG reporting with the
   Alphabet Carbon Manager. The result: smarter decisions, easier consulting, and simpler fleet
   management.
   
   [ Discover Connected Fleet ][41]
2. [Person sitting at a desk in a modern office, working on a computer with the Alphabet website
   open, surrounded by green plants and large windows.]
   
   ### AI-driven Fleet Reporting
   
   The award winning Alphabet AI Assistant transforms Fleet Reporting into a smart, intuitive
   experience. Just ask a question – the system delivers clear, data-based answers in seconds,
   helping you navigate complexity and make better decisions faster.
   
   [ More on Fleet Reporting ][42]
3. [Man with gray hair and a light sweater stands outdoors and smiles.]
   
   ### Sustainability
   
   Discover how Alphabet is driving sustainability through impactful initiatives in mobility, fleet
   electrification, and responsible business practices. Learn more about our environmental, social,
   and governance efforts in the latest ESG report.
   
   [ Discover our sustainability commitments ][43]

Solutions

## How we empower your fleet success

At Alphabet, we make business mobility easy by giving you access to powerful tools and expert
consulting across key areas of fleet management.
[Man shows content on a tablet to two people in a modern office.]

## Expert consultation for your fleet

Get expert advice tailored to your fleet, business goals, and industry. We help you optimise costs,
reduce emissions, and navigate complex topics like electrification and digitalisation. Our
consultants turn mobility challenges into strategic opportunities so your business stays efficient,
sustainable, and future-ready.
[ Consulting overview ][44]
[Three women discuss in front of a green car, holding a tablet.]

## Complete operational coverage

Tax and fine management, smart fuel and charging coordination, and seamless charging infrastructure
setup. Keep your fleet moving with fast replacement vehicles, reliable roadside assistance, and
always-on online services. To round it off, we offer safety and eco-driving training to help your
team drive better, safer, and smarter.
[ Consulting overview ][45]
Digital platforms and data-driven tools

## Smart tools for smart decisions

### Smart Tools, Smarter Mobility

Browse through our digital solutions to discover how each tool can enhance specific aspects of your
fleet management, from emission reduction and maximum flexibility to improved performance and cost
control.

Show more
[ Explore all our tools ][46]
[Welcome to the digital Alphabet Ecosystem message displayed over a blue, digital network
background.]

### 360 Fleet Portal

Get one-click access to all key Alphabet tools, from Carbon Manager and Fleet Reporting to rental
and servicing. The 360 Fleet Portal helps you simplify complexity, reduce admin effort and manage
your fleet with confidence.

Show more
[ Explore the 360 Fleet Portal ][47]
[Two women look at a curved monitor in a modern office environment.]

### AI-driven Fleet Reporting

Powered by AI, Alphabet’s Fleet Reporting delivers fast answers from your data. Ask a question, get
insights – and make smarter decisions to optimise costs and efficiency.

Show more
[ Explore Fleet Reporting ][48]
[Person sitting at a desk in a modern office, interacting with data on a widescreen monitor, with a
notebook and keyboard on the table and green plants in the background.]

### Alphabet Carbon Manager

Track, monitor, and reduce your entire fleet’s CO2 emissions. Our handy online platform automates
ESG reporting and in-depth analysis to help achieve your decarbonisation goals with tailored
guidance. Make decisions based on data-driven insights and keep a close eye on your progress to
ensure your ESG goals stay within reach.

Show more
[ Try Alphabet Carbon Manager ][49]
[A business professional gives a presentation to colleagues in a modern conference room, using a
large screen to display vehicle fleet emissions data.]

### Alphabet App

Give your drivers everything they need – in one app. The Alphabet App makes everyday mobility easier
with fuel and charging locations, contract access, service updates and digital licence checks, all
at your fingertips.

Show more
[ Discover the Alphabet App ][50]
[A woman uses her phone while the rear of a blue-grey car is visible in the background.]

### Popular Questions About Renting a Car in Europe

#### Can an American rent a car in Europe?

Of course! In most European countries, all Americans need is a valid US driver's license and
passport to rent a car in Europe. Be aware there are popular travel destinations that require
driver's from the United States to acquire an [International Driving Permit][49]; Italy is one of
these countries! IDP's are fairly cheap and can be acquired online before your trip or at a local
AAA branch. Contact Auto Europe for more information on your European car rental.

#### How old do you have to be to rent a car in Europe?

To rent a car in Europe, drivers must be at least 21 years old (age may vary by car category). Some
car rental suppliers will have rental options for drivers over the age of 18 and looking to rent a
car in Europe. Additionally, any driver hoping to [rent a car under the age of 25][50] may incur a
young driver surcharge in addition to the daily rate.

#### Do I need extra insurance when renting a car in Europe?

All Auto Europe Car Rentals include liability and fire insurance at no extra cost. Liability insures
against any damage done to anything outside of the rental car, while fire insurance protects against
mechanical fires. More comprehensive coverage typically includes a Collision Damage Waiver (CDW)
insuring damage done to the rental car in the event of an accident and Theft Protection to cover the
loss if the rental vehicle is stolen while you are in Europe. When [renting a car in Italy][51], it
is required renters purchase CDW and Theft Protection in their insurance plan. Check with your
reservation agent what is required at your destination.

Find more information from Auto Europe on [car rental insurance in Europe][52].

#### How much is a rental car per day in Europe?

Similar to airline tickets, the cost per day to rent a car varies greatly based on your destination,
the time of year, and the car class you choose to rent. Economy and smaller-sized rentals can be as
little as $15-$20 a day in popular cities in France and Italy. Luxury vehicles & SUVs will have
higher daily rates but keep an eye out for specials or promotions; in some countries, Auto Europe
provides free car class upgrades on rentals throughout the year.

Find more [questions and answers about renting a car in Europe][53] with Auto Europe today!

### Popular Questions About Renting a Car in Europe

#### Can an American rent a car in Europe?

Of course! In most European countries, all Americans need is a valid US driver's license and
passport to rent a car in Europe. Be aware there are popular travel destinations that require
driver's from the United States to acquire an [International Driving Permit][49]; Italy is one of
these countries! IDP's are fairly cheap and can be acquired online before your trip or at a local
AAA branch. Contact Auto Europe for more information on your European car rental.

#### How old do you have to be to rent a car in Europe?

To rent a car in Europe, drivers must be at least 21 years old (age may vary by car category). Some
car rental suppliers will have rental options for drivers over the age of 18 and looking to rent a
car in Europe. Additionally, any driver hoping to [rent a car under the age of 25][50] may incur a
young driver surcharge in addition to the daily rate.

#### Do I need extra insurance when renting a car in Europe?

All Auto Europe Car Rentals include liability and fire insurance at no extra cost. Liability insures
against any damage done to anything outside of the rental car, while fire insurance protects against
mechanical fires. More comprehensive coverage typically includes a Collision Damage Waiver (CDW)
insuring damage done to the rental car in the event of an accident and Theft Protection to cover the
loss if the rental vehicle is stolen while you are in Europe. When [renting a car in Italy][51], it
is required renters purchase CDW and Theft Protection in their insurance plan. Check with your
reservation agent what is required at your destination.

Find more information from Auto Europe on [car rental insurance in Europe][52].

#### How much is a rental car per day in Europe?

Similar to airline tickets, the cost per day to rent a car varies greatly based on your destination,
the time of year, and the car class you choose to rent. Economy and smaller-sized rentals can be as
little as $15-$20 a day in popular cities in France and Italy. Luxury vehicles & SUVs will have
higher daily rates but keep an eye out for specials or promotions; in some countries, Auto Europe
provides free car class upgrades on rentals throughout the year.

Find more [questions and answers about renting a car in Europe][53] with Auto Europe today!

innovative multi-mobility options and fleet management expertise. Our aim is to provide businesses
and individuals across India with smarter, greener, and more efficient ways to move, supported by
our dedicated team and user-friendly digital platforms. Let Ayvens drive your mobility forward.

cost-effective solutions without compromising on quality. Our commitment to customer satisfaction

at any time, be it during the booking process or throughout your rental experience.

EconomyBookings.com is not just a booking platform; it’s your trusted partner in travel, dedicated
to making your car rental experience seamless and enjoyable. Explore our user-friendly website today

sales, support or development you are communicating with someone that has deep knowledge of the car
rental industry across multiple countries and customers.

### Less time on admin

Everything you need to manage your car rental website is in one place. Carcloud.com automatically
detects new vehicles so you just need to add marketing details and imagery. Work smarter with
Marketing and Online Booking fully connected and working together in one seamless platform
Automation saves you time while still giving you full control when you need it.

### More control of rates

Your car rental software lets you create different rates - but what if each rate needs a different
customer experience? In Carcloud.com, for every single rate in your reservation software you can
define different booking flows, promotional messages, email confirmations, payment methods and terms
& conditions.

## Get more direct bookings

##### Increase your revenue with a booking process designed for conversions.

Grow bookings through organic traffic or using configurable landing pages for paid traffic. Boost
revenue using upgrade promotions and booking alerts - and run outbound campaigns with coupons and
deep links.

### More repeat customers

Drive loyalty through our integrated login, CRM and email solutions that allow full automation over
customer communications with drag-and-drop configuration. Track loyalty and run full marketing
campaigns with in-built customer segmentation and purchase tracking. Execute campaigns in-house or
leverage our extended digital team.

### Grow through B2B

Your car rental software lets you create different rates - but what if each rate needs a different
customer experience? In Carcloud.com, for every single rate in your reservation software you can
define different booking flows, promotional messages, email confirmations, payment methods and terms
& conditions.

## Drive profits through inbound

##### Supercharge your revenue with more business from the lucrative international travel market.

We support car rental companies around the world with multi-language, multi-currency and multiple
trusted payment providers. We work with customers that operate across multiple countries and
boundaries, with different regional rules. Carcloud.com also connects to Skyscanner and Kayak to
drive qualified traffic to your website.

## 12+ years running car rental websites. Millions of confirmed rentals.

## The proven partner for car rental companies

##### Have you experienced failed technology projects or unreliable developers? If so, you’re aware
##### of the risks when choosing a development partner.

Most digital agencies haven’t worked with car rental booking APIs. We’ve been doing this for over 10
years and we’re with you for the full journey. When you trust us with your website, you’re in safe
hands.

### Enterprise-grade features

We work with some of the biggest names in car rental and can provide custom SLA, your own release
cycle, multiple environments and private custom development.

### Insight and reporting

Out-of-the-box integration with Google Analytics enhanced eCommerce reporting to track your revenue
growth. If you need to get under the hood, you can view detailed logs to understand communication
with your reservation software.

## Future-proof your business

##### For over a decade, Carcloud.com has been exclusively building and managing websites and tools
##### for car rental companies.

Our full-time car rental development team works as an extension of your business. We continually
invest in R&D, giving you the tools you need to beat the competition.

## Transparent onboarding process

We’ve already built a world-class car rental website platform, filled with features that will
increase your revenue. This means that during onboarding we focus on what’s unique for your
business. During the sales process you will get a full demonstration of all available features.
During the design process you’ll see full Figma templates showing all page layouts so that you can
see how your final website will look and provide feedback. Our front-end team will then implement
the final design while our content and configuration team bring it to life.

## We’ve got you covered with 24x7 support

##### Product knowledge base, regular updates and release notes, car rental support portal and
##### ticketing.

We continually monitor websites and infrastructure to ensure your business is taking bookings. We
also give you tools to monitor what’s going on with your integrated car rental software so you can
self diagnose any issues they may have.

The technology used is necessary to keep our website secure and our applications running. These
cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off (they do not identify

  Duration: Session
  Description: This cookie allows the website to tie together pageviews into a session as you make a

* Name: CarRental_Storage
  Duration: 1 year
  Description: This cookie allows the website to set site settings you have selected on your
  previous visit (eg currency, language, etc).

  Duration: Session
  Description: Incapsula DDoS Protection and Web Application Firewall cookie for linking HTTP
  requests to a certain session (visit). Re-opening the browser and accessing same site are
  registered as different visits. In order to maintain existing sessions (ie, session cookie).
* Name: visid_incap_
  Duration: 1 year
  Description: Incapsula DDoS Protection and Web Application Firewall cookie for linking certain
  sessions to a specific visitor (visitor representing a specific computer). In order to identify
  clients that have already visited Incapsula.
* Name: _GRECAPTCHA
  Duration: resets depending on the user’s actions (clicks)
  Description: reCAPTCHA sets this necessary cookie when executed for the purpose of providing its
  risk analysis. It checks if the page is used by a person or a robot. It analyses the use without
  showing a challenge to the user.

  Duration: Session
  Description: Collaborates with .AspNetCore.Session to provide protection against Cross-site
  request forgery (also known as XSRF or CSRF).

  Duration: 1 year
  Description: Sets the currency selection for the page.

  Description: It’s created when the user dismisses the cookie info bar on the site so it is not

about us

## we are an
## ambitious team

We are a software company driven by the ambition to make private mobility solutions truly
accessible, flexible, and efficient.

Read more

Imagine a future where everybody can use sustainable mobility services whenever and wherever it
suits them. With years of experience operating in the global mobility market and considerable
technological expertise, we have the confidence to carry out this mission. Our team of international
talents is responsible for maintaining the service that provides car rental customers access to over
four million vehicles worldwide.

## CarCloud

CarCloud supports desk-based, hybrid, and keyless rental models. The platform helps fleet operators
boost efficiency, profitability, and customer satisfaction.

Automate the entire rental journey, from start to finish.

Maximise fleet performance with AI allocation, demand-based pricing, and live tracking.

End-to-end tracking of damage, claims, and maintenance.

Total control of inventory, from rental extras to spare parts.

[ Learn More about CarCloud ][22]
[Carcloud macbook]
Vehicle as a service

## Making private mobility
## accessible for VAAS

[Private car icon]

### Private cars are underutilised

Privately owned cars spend nearly 95% of the time idle, utilising only a fraction of their actual
capacity. We are changing this by making private mobility efficient and sustainable.

[Key access icon]

### Access over ownership

More and more people are embracing the benefits of having access to a vehicle rather than owning it.
They enjoy the comfort and security of a private vehicle without the burden of maintenance or
worrying about passing the technical inspection.

[Multimodal transport icon]

### Flexible use cases

Vehicles are available to meet a range of needs, whether on an hourly, daily or monthly basis. Our
platform adapts to both personal and business requirements, providing simple and efficient access.

[MaaS icon]

### Private mobility, redefined

Car Rental Gateway enables VaaS across all private mobility services, including scheduled and
subscription-based options, as well as on-demand vehicle use starting from 25 kilometres.

# Who are we?

CarRentalNet is a Business-to-business (B2B) e-commerce solution for the car rental industry. We’re
one of the top converting platforms available. Our services are proven to earn you the most revenue,
since we focus on delivering a seamless and easy-to-use service for your customers. Every search
connects your customers with quality car rental providers, offering a variety of choices and optimal
pricing for a smooth travel experience.

More than 6000 locations all over the world!

Top international and leading local car rental companies!

Low rates - High commission! The best possible deals for every car rental!

# How it works?
* 1. Sign up [here][7] and a representative will contact you within a few days.
* 2. Make your adjustments to the provided site and/or create your car rental components.
* 3. Add your components to your website or share your site links.
* 4. Watch your revenue grow!

# Need help?

#### Looking to become an Affiliate?

If you want to increase your revenue using our affiliate program you can contact us directly through
[Affiliates Contact][8].

#### Wanting to partner your Car Rental Brand with us?

If you want to display your car rentals on CarRentalNet you can contact us [here][9].

#### Having a question about your booking?

If you have any questions about your booking you can contact us [here][10].

#### Cookie Preference Centre

Find out how each cookie category works and choose your settings [Cookie Policy][11]

Manage cookies:

Strictly Necessary Always Active

The technology used is necessary to keep our website secure and our applications running. These
cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off (they do not identify
you personally).

[Technical Details][12]
* Name: CarRental
  Duration: Session
  Description: This cookie allows the website to tie together pageviews into a session as you make a
  journey through the website without losing your selections.
* Name: CarRental_Storage
  Duration: 1 year
  Description: This cookie allows the website to set site settings you have selected on your
  previous visit (eg currency, language, etc).
* Name: incap_ses_
  Duration: Session
  Description: Incapsula DDoS Protection and Web Application Firewall cookie for linking HTTP
  requests to a certain session (visit). Re-opening the browser and accessing same site are
  registered as different visits. In order to maintain existing sessions (ie, session cookie).
* Name: visid_incap_
  Duration: 1 year
  Description: Incapsula DDoS Protection and Web Application Firewall cookie for linking certain
  sessions to a specific visitor (visitor representing a specific computer). In order to identify
  clients that have already visited Incapsula.
* Name: _GRECAPTCHA
  Duration: resets depending on the user’s actions (clicks)
  Description: reCAPTCHA sets this necessary cookie when executed for the purpose of providing its
  risk analysis. It checks if the page is used by a person or a robot. It analyses the use without
  showing a challenge to the user.
* Name: .AspNetCore.Antiforgery
  Duration: Session
  Description: Collaborates with .AspNetCore.Session to provide protection against Cross-site
  request forgery (also known as XSRF or CSRF).
* Name: uCurr
  Duration: 1 year
  Description: Sets the currency selection for the page.
* Name: cookiepolicymsg
  Duration: 180 days
  Description: It’s created when the user dismisses the cookie info bar on the site so it is not
  visible on every other page visit/refresh.
* Name: ts
  Duration: 3 years
  Description: This cookie is used in context with the PayPal payment-function on the website. It is
  necessary for making a safe transaction through PayPal.
* Name: ts_c
  Duration: 3 years
  Description: This cookie is used in context with the PayPal payment-function on the website. It is
  necessary for making a safe transaction through PayPal.
* Name: akavp

* 1. Sign up [here][7] and a representative will contact you within a few days.
* 2. Make your adjustments to the provided site and/or create your car rental components.
* 3. Add your components to your website or share your site links.
* 4. Watch your revenue grow!

# Need help?

#### Looking to become an Affiliate?

If you want to increase your revenue using our affiliate program you can contact us directly through
[Affiliates Contact][8].

#### Wanting to partner your Car Rental Brand with us?

If you want to display your car rentals on CarRentalNet you can contact us [here][9].

#### Having a question about your booking?

If you have any questions about your booking you can contact us [here][10].

#### Cookie Preference Centre

Find out how each cookie category works and choose your settings [Cookie Policy][11]

Manage cookies:

Strictly Necessary Always Active

The technology used is necessary to keep our website secure and our applications running. These
cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off (they do not identify
you personally).

[Technical Details][12]
* Name: CarRental
  Duration: Session
  Description: This cookie allows the website to tie together pageviews into a session as you make a
  journey through the website without losing your selections.
* Name: CarRental_Storage
  Duration: 1 year
  Description: This cookie allows the website to set site settings you have selected on your
  previous visit (eg currency, language, etc).
* Name: incap_ses_
  Duration: Session
  Description: Incapsula DDoS Protection and Web Application Firewall cookie for linking HTTP
  requests to a certain session (visit). Re-opening the browser and accessing same site are
  registered as different visits. In order to maintain existing sessions (ie, session cookie).
* Name: visid_incap_
  Duration: 1 year
  Description: Incapsula DDoS Protection and Web Application Firewall cookie for linking certain
  sessions to a specific visitor (visitor representing a specific computer). In order to identify
  clients that have already visited Incapsula.
* Name: _GRECAPTCHA
  Duration: resets depending on the user’s actions (clicks)
  Description: reCAPTCHA sets this necessary cookie when executed for the purpose of providing its
  risk analysis. It checks if the page is used by a person or a robot. It analyses the use without
  showing a challenge to the user.
* Name: .AspNetCore.Antiforgery
  Duration: Session
  Description: Collaborates with .AspNetCore.Session to provide protection against Cross-site
  request forgery (also known as XSRF or CSRF).
* Name: uCurr
  Duration: 1 year
  Description: Sets the currency selection for the page.
* Name: cookiepolicymsg
  Duration: 180 days
  Description: It’s created when the user dismisses the cookie info bar on the site so it is not
  visible on every other page visit/refresh.
* Name: ts
  Duration: 3 years
  Description: This cookie is used in context with the PayPal payment-function on the website. It is
  necessary for making a safe transaction through PayPal.
* Name: ts_c
  Duration: 3 years
  Description: This cookie is used in context with the PayPal payment-function on the website. It is
  necessary for making a safe transaction through PayPal.
* Name: akavpau_ppsd
  Duration: Session
  Description: This cookie is used in context with the PayPal payment-function on the website. It is
  necessary for making a safe transaction through PayPal.

Performance / Analytics

In order to improve your browsing experience on our website we use technology that provide us with
information on how you use our site. In this way, we analyze the traffic to our website and relevant
usage. (they do not identify you personally).

[Technical Details][13]
* Name: _ga
  Duration: 2 years
  Description: This cookie is used by Google Analytics to evaluate user visit goals, report Website
  activity to site operators, and improve customer experience by visiting the site.
* Name: _gid
  Duration: 1 year
  Description: Google Analytics analytics cookie used to distinguish users.
* Name: _ym_isad
  Duration: 1 day
  Description: This Yandex cookie determines whether a User has ad-blockers.
* Name: _ym_d
  Duration: 1 year
  Description: These Yandex cookies save the date of the user’s first site session.
* Name: _ym_uid
  Duration: 1 year
  Description: These Yandex cookies are used for distinguish site users.
* Name: _ yandexuid
  Duration: 1 year
  Description: This Yandex cookie is used for distinguish site users.
* Name: AMP_TOKEN
  Duration: 1 year
  Description: This cookie is used by Google Analytics and it contains a token that can be used to
  retrieve a Client ID from AMP Client ID service.

Functional / Marketing

They enhance functionality and they can personalize content for you. As an example they can
recognize you when you return to our website, they record choices you have made and allow us to
tailor our website to your needs, e.g. if you set your location, we use cookies to save your
location. They also show us the performance of our marketing activities in general (they do not
identify you personally). Find out more about [Google’s Privacy & Terms][14].

[Technical Details][15]
* Name: IDE
  Duration: 1 year
  Description: Used by Google DoubleClick and stores information about how the user uses the website
  and any other advertisement before visiting the website. This is used to present users with ads
  that are relevant to them according to the user profile.
* Name: _gcl_au
  Duration: 3 months
  Description: It's a first party cookie for "Conversion Linker" functionality - it takes
  information in ad clicks and stores it in a first-party cookie so that conversions can be
  attributed outside the landing page.
* Name: _gat
  Duration: 1 minute
  Description: Used to throttle request rate. If Google Analytics is deployed via Google Tag
  Manager, this cookie will be named _dc_gtm_UA-***.

## Rent a Car u Beogradu sa 15 godina iskustva i kvalitetom koji stoji iza CARWIZ imena

Iznajmljivanje auta u Beogradu treba da bude jednostavno. Mi smo Carwiz Rent a Car i već više od 15
godina pomažemo ljudima da brzo i bez komplikacija dođu do vozila. Kao deo CARWIZ sistema, nudimo
lokalnu uslugu uz standarde velikog međunarodnog brenda.

## Naše lokacije u Beogradu i Nišu

Naše poslovnice su na lokacijama koje klijentima zaista znače, bilo da dolazite avionom ili vam je
automobil potreban u gradu.:
* **Aerodrom Nikola Tesla (BEG):** Poslovnica se nalazi odmah pored aerodromske zgrade, u zoni rent
  a car kompanija, pa nas možete lako pronaći čim sletite. Preuzimanje vozila je brzo i jednostavno,
  bez nepotrebnog zadržavanja.
* **Novi Beograd (Poslovnica Arena):**Ova lokacija je praktična za sve koji borave u gradu, kao i za
  poslovne korisnike. Nalazimo se u blizini Štark Arene, sa dobrim pristupom auto-putu i bez potrebe
  da prolazite kroz centar grada.
* **Aerodrom Niš:** Na raspolaganju smo i putnicima koji sleću na Aerodrom Konstantin Veliki, uz
  isti nivo usluge i jednostavnu proceduru preuzimanja vozila.

## Vozni park prilagođen vašim potrebama

Sa flotom od preko **500 vozila** starosti do dve godine, garantujemo pouzdanost i udobnost. Iako
nudimo preko 25 kategorija vozila, naši klijenti u Beogradu najčešće biraju:
* **VW Golf 8:** Odličan izbor za one koji traže udoban i siguran auto, podjednako praktičan za
  gradsku vožnju i otvoren put.
* **Škoda Superb:** Favorit poslovnih korisnika koji traže prostor i eleganciju.
* **Economy grupa (Fiat 500 i slični):** Najbolji odnos cene i lakoće parkiranja u beogradskim
  zonama.

## Jasna pravila: Depozit i osiguranje bez skrivenih troškova

Transparentnost je naš prioritet. Znamo da su depozit i učešće u šteti najčešća pitanja klijenata:
* **Depozit:** Rezerviše se isključivo putem platne kartice prilikom preuzimanja vozila.
* **Minimalni depozit:** Uz naše dodatno osiguranje (SCDW), depozit za ekonomična vozila poput
  **Fiata 500 iznosi samo 210 EUR**.
* **Puna zaštita:** Pored standardnih cena, uvek možete dokupiti osiguranje bez učešća u šteti kako
  biste putovali potpuno rasterećeni.


Rezervišite svoje vozilo online putem našeg sajta, pozovite nas na **+381 11 418 19 23** ili
pošaljite upit na [reservations@carwiz.rs][42].

  preko 400 novih vozi

## Rent a Car u Beogradu sa 15 godina iskustva i kvalitetom koji stoji iza CARWIZ imena

Iznajmljivanje auta u Beogradu treba da bude jednostavno. Mi smo Carwiz Rent a Car i već više od 15
godina pomažemo ljudima da brzo i bez komplikacija dođu do vozila. Kao deo CARWIZ sistema, nudimo
lokalnu uslugu uz standarde velikog međunarodnog brenda.

## Naše lokacije u Beogradu i Nišu

Naše poslovnice su na lokacijama koje klijentima zaista znače, bilo da dolazite avionom ili vam je
automobil potreban u gradu.:
* **Aerodrom Nikola Tesla (BEG):** Poslovnica se nalazi odmah pored aerodromske zgrade, u zoni rent
  a car kompanija, pa nas možete lako pronaći čim sletite. Preuzimanje vozila je brzo i jednostavno,
  bez nepotrebnog zadržavanja.
* **Novi Beograd (Poslovnica Arena):**Ova lokacija je praktična za sve koji borave u gradu, kao i za
  poslovne korisnike. Nalazimo se u blizini Štark Arene, sa dobrim pristupom auto-putu i bez potrebe
  da prolazite kroz centar grada.
* **Aerodrom Niš:** Na raspolaganju smo i putnicima koji sleću na Aerodrom Konstantin Veliki, uz
  isti nivo usluge i jednostavnu proceduru preuzimanja vozila.

## Vozni park prilagođen vašim potrebama

Sa flotom od preko **500 vozila** starosti do dve godine, garantujemo pouzdanost i udobnost. Iako
nudimo preko 25 kategorija vozila, naši klijenti u Beogradu najčešće biraju:
* **VW Golf 8:** Odličan izbor za one koji traže udoban i siguran auto, podjednako praktičan za
  gradsku vožnju i otvoren put.
* **Škoda Superb:** Favorit poslovnih korisnika koji traže prostor i eleganciju.
* **Economy grupa (Fiat 500 i slični):** Najbolji odnos cene i lakoće parkiranja u beogradskim
  zonama.

## Jasna pravila: Depozit i osiguranje bez skrivenih troškova

Transparentnost je naš prioritet. Znamo da su depozit i učešće u šteti najčešća pitanja klijenata:
* **Depozit:** Rezerviše se isključivo putem platne kartice prilikom preuzimanja vozila.
* **Minimalni depozit:** Uz naše dodatno osiguranje (SCDW), depozit za ekonomična vozila poput
  **Fiata 500 iznosi samo 210 EUR**.
* **Puna zaštita:** Pored standardnih cena, uvek možete dokupiti osiguranje bez učešća u šteti kako
  biste putovali potpuno rasterećeni.


Rezervišite svoje vozilo online putem našeg sajta, pozovite nas na **+381 11 418 19 23** ili
pošaljite upit na [reservations@carwiz.rs][42].

Drivalia wants to represent the “Planet of Mobility” of the future, providing its customers with the
widest range of mobility solutions: from electric car sharing to innovative car subscriptions,
passing through short, medium, and long-term rental.

Drivalias’ modern fleet of rental vehicles caters to all requirements. Economical, urban cars are
ideal for short stay city breaks whilst the SUV range is perfect for families ready to explore
further afield.

Need something a little bigger? Spacious people carriers cater to larger groups and for business
users, the executive car range features some of the best and most prestigious models available. Book

## About Car Club

Car club is a premier car rental company founded with a vision of becoming a leader in “Ground
Transportation” for both personal and corporate travel. Car club is backed by panel of experienced
Industry experts who have collective experience of more than 100 years. The company had started
operations with the fleet size of 225 cars in 8 cities during October 2007. The company is funded by
Berggruen Holdings Inc LA.

Car club has grown from strength to strength since the inception, and today the company operates a
fleet of about 3500 cars in 112 cities servicing over 1500 corporate houses and many luxury hotels,
recognized as one of the preferred car rental supplier. Car club has set up multiple car dispatching
facilities in each city to reach the customer faster and in the process cut down idle time &
mileage. In the 112 cities where Car club services are available, it has set up 150 operating
locations which are operational 24X7.

Car club offer chauffeur driven car rental services to its customers across all these cities through
its wide range of brand new fleet of cars. The fleet of cars includes entry level Economy cars,
multi-utility vans, sedans and SUVs.

[Read More...][46]

In the chauffeur drive segment, car club offers airport transfers, half day and full day rentals
within the city limits, inter-city journeys, monthly hiring with or without chauffeurs and with or
without fuel etc. The rental options are wide and can be customized to suit the needs of the
travellers. The fleet of cars for Chauffeur drive rentals comprises of cars ranging from Mid-size to
Super luxury segment manufactured by Ford, Toyota, Honda, VW, Maruti, Nissan, BMW, Mercedes Benz,
Audi etc. Car club also offers luxury vans and coaches across its network cities on hire. This
segment includes vehicles such as VW Crafter, Mercedes Viano, Toyota Commuter, Volvo coaches etc.

Car club also offers weekend chauffeur driven holiday packages to tourist and pilgrimage interested
places. This door to door services offers hassle free rentals with 100% reliability on service
delivery. Car club chauffeurs are well trained by M/s.Hubert Ebner for safety driving skills and
trained by in house personnel for soft skills.

Car club through its international affiliate Tristar Worldwide Services, offers chauffeur drive
services in 89 countries in the world covering Europe, Americas & Canada, Asia and Australia. Car
club offers centralized invoicing and payment options for international usages in India.

Car club accepts all the credit cards including Master, Visa and American Express through its
secured payment gateway. The invoicing process is 100% accurate with complete transparency on
charges. Car club offers special deals during weekend on chauffeur drive rentals.

On the technology front, car club has launched mobile app for both customers and chauffeurs. The
salient features of mobile app for the customers enables, ease of reservations, tracking of
vehicles, data on route taken during the rental along with time & mileage details. At the stroke of
the button customers can reserve, modify, cancel the reservations at their ease. The chauffeurs have
been provided with mobile app to cut down on idle time & mileage while reporting to the customers.

Car club aims to expand its network to over 150+ cities in India by 2023-24 thus by investing on
fleet, infrastructure and technology.

EFS and Fleet One solutions by WEX Fleet help owner-operators and major carriers alike run smarter
and more efficiently. Find the fleet solutions you need to stay ahead.

### Competitive discounts for growing fleets

Every dollar you save gives your growing fleet the edge it needs. The Fleet One EDGE Card helps you
save thousands per year in fuel discounts alone, and gives you big discounts on tires, maintenance,
wireless plans, and more.

[Fleet One EDGE Card][37]

EFS helps freight carriers unlock the value behind payments, so you can focus on making your
business the best it can be. EFS fuel cards set the standard for security and control, with add-on
solutions to improve efficiency and performance based on your exact needs.

# Driving your business to the **future of mobility**

 

Global leader in Mobility Software, specialising in Rental, Subscription, Leasing and Chauffeur.
Explore our **two leading products**:

Find out more

Find out more

### **Partners that trust Emotion**

## Discover how we empower** mobility operators worldwide** by digitalising their fleet operations

##### Rental

Gain complete control over your car, truck or motorcycle rental operations with end-to-end
management capabilities.

##### Subscription

Configure your fleet to offer vehicle-as-a-service, prioritising your customers flexbility needs in
a digital solution.

##### Leasing

Enhance your control over long-term rentals and operational leasing activities with comprehensive
management tools.

##### Chauffeur

Coordinate both vehicle
and driver for chauffeur or
limousine driven services.

#### **Our International Footprint**

**Our impact extends globally, serving ****500+** ** partners in more than ****90+ countries**** and
managing a fleet of over**** 1m+ vehicles**

#### What is **Emotion**?

 

Emotion is the next chapter in our transformative journey, building upon the legacy of our
world-renowned products, Rentway and Carpro, and continuing to deliver more innovative mobility
solutions.

As we embrace a new identity, our vision is crystal clear – to become the global leader in mobility
software, pioneering best-practice technology that sets the standard for cutting-edge solutions for
rental, leasing, subscription and beyond.

[Emotion Car White]

#### **Mission**

Our mission is to deliver the most comprehensive and reliable fleet management software for mobility
businesses worldwide, empowering partners to respond rapidly to their market and customer needs.

#### **Vision**

Our vision is to be the global leader in mobility software, delivering best-practice technology that
is recognized as
a vanguard of mobility solutions.

#### Driving the Future of Mobility

Emotion is committed to shaping the future of mobility, where solution providers and consumers can
navigate a world of possibilities effortlessly. With our robust fleet management software, mobility
businesses gain a competitive edge, unlocking new opportunities and enhancing customer experience.

##### Our values

#### Reliability

#### Reliability

Change is not a matter of moving aimlessly, but of moving in the right direction. And to achieve
this we have to work with control and accuracy, managing each variable. Our almost thirty years of
experience provide us with the necessary thoroughness to guarantee every result.

#### Empowerment

#### Empowerment

We like that feeling of security and power that comes from having everything under control; it is an
attitude of leadership that allows us to make wise decisions, with the confidence of knowing that we
are getting things right. We like to convey this feeling to our team and our clients to make them
grow, and to grow alongside them.

#### Quality

#### Quality

We have a best-in-class tool, coupled with the excellent service provided by our support and back-up
department. We have different IT and training programs, and state-of-the-art technology. This is the
only way to get truly competitive software for those who need to stay one step ahead.

#### Modernity

section on our “Campaigns” page. You can also stay updated on our offers by enabling communication
permissions, allowing us to send you SMS and mobile app notifications for prompt announcements.
* **How Can I Use Partnership Offers?**

visiting our “Campaigns” page. Once you’ve obtained a discount code from the relevant page, you can
book at favorable rates by specifying your desired car.
* **What Are “Garenta-Exclusive” Offers?**

You can discover the advantages available to Garenta members when shopping with various brands in
the dedicated “Garentan-Exclusive” section on our “Campaigns” page. You can take full advantage of
the respective brand’s offerings by reviewing the usage details. To receive a discount code from us,
please ensure that you have enabled SMS and mobile application push notification permissions.

**How Can I Book a Car?**

reservation directly without requiring membership. However, completing the membership process
through the Garenta website or mobile app, visiting one of our offices across Türkiye, or contacting
our Booking Center will provide a faster and more seamless rental experience. 

**What is the Minimum Duration for a Rental Period?**
The minimum rental period is 24 hours. For rentals that are less than one day (24 hours), a daily
rental fee applies.

**Will I Receive the Same Make and Model Car I Booked? **
The car images displayed on our website and mobile application serve as representative examples of
the respective car classes. We cannot guarantee the availability of the specific make, model, or
color of the car requested in the booking. Based on the real-time availability of cars at the time
of delivery, it’s possible that a different car from the same class with similar features may be
provided.

**Are There Alternative Payment Methods Besides Credit Cards? **
We exclusively accept Visa and Mastercard credit cards as payment methods, and virtual cards and
debit cards are not accepted. 

**I Don’t Use a Credit Card / My Card Doesn’t Have Sufficient Limit: Can I Split the Payment Across
Multiple Cards or Use Someone Else’s Credit Card for Payment?**
The vehicle rental fee, along with any additional product and service charges and the security
deposit, is collected in advance from the renter's own credit card(s) at the beginning of the rental
period. Payments can be made using multiple credit cards belonging to the same person; however,
third-party credit cards cannot be used. Any additional charges or refunds during the rental period
will also be processed through the same card(s).
**Can I Pay Later?**
During the booking process, you have the option to select “Pay Later” as your payment method,
allowing you to complete the payment at our offices when you pick up your car. If preferred, you can
secure your booking at discounted rates by utilizing our “Pay Now” option.

**What are the Terms & Conditions for Cancellation/Refund?**

In prepaid reservations, if the reservation is canceled at least 1 hour before the vehicle pickup
time, the full rental fee will be refunded. If the cancellation is made less than 1 hour before the
rental start time, a penalty fee of 30% of the total amount will be charged.

**If I Return The Car Earlier Than Planned, Will I Get a Refund for The Unused Days?**

In case of early return, a penalty fee of 15% of the unused rental days will be charged, and the
remaining amount will be refunded.

**When Will I Receive My Invoice?**
Your invoice will be sent to the email address you provided at the beginning of the rental within 7
business days after your rental ends.

**Can I Be Sure That I Will Rent The Exact Car I Reserved?**
Reservations are made based on vehicle groups, and a specific model is not guaranteed. If a car from
your reserved group is unavailable at the specified time, a higher-segment car will be provided at
the same price.

An additional driver can be added to the rental agreement. However, if you are the main driver, you
must visit the office with both the car and the additional driver. A damage inspection will be

You can only rent one car at a time. However, you can make a separate reservation for a different

section. Any excess mileage at the time of return will be charged based on the current mileage

the vehicle group. You can find detailed information on our website or by contacting our Reservation
Center.

You can contact us by filling out the communication form via [Garenta Contact][32].

apply. One-way fees vary by location and can be viewed during the reservation process. For more
details, you can contact our Reservation Center.

you. In Europe you will have our toll-free-from-Europe “safety net” help line via which, around the

supplier, no matter where you are; at the rental counter, on the road, or at your hotel. We are your
advocate with the supplier. Any post-rental billing issues with the supplier you turn over to us and
we deal with them. Our voucher protects you against these charges. Unless they are listed on the
voucher, you will be refunded.

**Without Gemüt.com - Self-Service Online Booking: **You make the booking yourself online. If
changes are required, you make them online. If there are problems at the rental counter (wrong car,
no car, unexpected fees, etc.) you will deal with it yourself. For post-rental billing issues you
resolve them directly with the supplier.

## **Top Coolest Headquarters in the World**

Discover the top coolest headquarters and corporate offices in the world—iconic workplaces known for
innovative design, creative architecture, and inspiring office environments. These world-class
company headquarters set new standards for modern corporate office culture, blending functionality
with bold aesthetics to create spaces that employees genuinely enjoy working in every day.

From cutting-edge technology campuses to architecturally stunning corporate offices, these
headquarters showcase how thoughtful design, open collaboration spaces, and employee-focused
amenities can transform the workplace experience. Each headquarters highlights unique approaches to
office layout, sustainability, wellness, and creativity, making them a powerful source of
inspiration for corporate office management teams and business leaders worldwide.

To explore these incredible headquarters in action and see what makes them stand out, watch the
video below for a visual tour of some of the coolest corporate offices in the world:

If you have ever wondered what it would be like to work in a truly inspiring corporate environment,
these headquarters represent the ultimate vision of modern office life. They are not just
offices—they are destinations that reflect company culture, innovation, and forward-thinking
leadership, and they continue to influence how organizations design and manage their headquarters
across the globe.

## **What can you find in a company headquarters?**

In a company headquarters, you will typically find the organization’s leadership team along with its
most critical business functions. These departments and offices work together to manage strategy,
operations, and long-term growth:
* **Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Office** – Responsible for overall vision, leadership, and
  strategic decision-making.
* **Executive Team & Board of Directors** – Oversees corporate governance, policy direction, and
  high-level business objectives.
* **Administration Office** – Handles internal coordination, office management, and organizational
  support functions.
* **Finance, Accounting & Billing Department** – Manages budgets, financial reporting, payroll,
  billing, and compliance.
* **Marketing & Communications Department** – Develops branding, public relations, advertising, and
  internal and external communications.
* **Sales Department** – Drives revenue generation, client acquisition, and business development
  efforts.
* **Customer Service & Support** – Provides assistance to customers, manages inquiries, and resolves
  issues.
* **Research & Development Department** – Focuses on innovation, product development, and improving
  existing services or technologies.
* **Operations & Logistics** – Oversees daily business operations, supply chains, and operational
  efficiency.
* **Human Resources Department** – Manages recruitment, employee relations, benefits, training, and
  workplace policies.
* **Legal Department** – Handles contracts, regulatory compliance, risk management, and legal
  matters affecting the company.

Together, these offices form the operational and strategic core of a company, making the
headquarters the central hub for leadership, planning, and decision-making.

the booking time begins.

Cancellation refunding will be done through the original mode of payment within 7-10 business days. 

How will I receive my refund?

A refund will be initiated into the account/ card used to make the payment and will take up to 7-10
days

Are there restrictions on where I can drive?

Most of our Limecar vehicles are equipped with an All Goa Permit which means that you are free to
drive anywhere within the state. Please visit our domestic section for more tips on traveling within
the state. Kindly avoid restricted areas like off-road driving and driving on the beaches.

What would be the fuel level of the vehicle allotted to me?

Fuel level in most vehicles might be as low as 5-10%. Post completing the pick-up checklist
procedure. Please check the level of fuel in the vehicle you have rented and fill the tank up as per
your requirement if the current level of fuel is not enough. 

Can someone else drive the Limecar vehicle that has been rented on my name?

Yes, someone other than you to drive the Limecar vehicle you have rented. To do so, you will need to
provide us with a copy of the driver's license of the person who will be driving the car. Once we
have verified the license, we will allow that person to drive the vehicle.

How do I find my car?

Finding the vehicle is an easy process. Two hours before the start of your booking, we will send you
an SMS and an email on your registered mobile number containing the exact details of your vehicle,
as well as the phone number of the delivery executive. You can use these details to track the
location of your car and reach it on time.

Is Limecar 24/7?

Yes, all Limecar locations are open 24/7 for you to schedule your pickup and drop-off at any given
time. Our call center is open around the clock to help you with your bookings or other issues you
might be facing. 

What do I do if I face any hassles?

Our Customer Support is available 24/7 across Goa. Help is never far away from you.

## Why us?
* No fine print
  We never hide our prices, terms and conditions. No hidden fees or taxes. You can see the exact
  price that will not change in the booking process.
* Low deposits
  In international rental companies deposits may reach up to several thousand euros, which will be
  blocked on the client’s bank account. Our average deposit is 300 euros, and we have plenty of car
  rental companies that do not require deposits at all.
* Fair damage assessment
  We assess damage in the presence of a client. Our prices are 2-3 times lower than in international
  car rental companies. And we never charge our clients after they have returned the car.

## Reviews

## Why us?
* No fine print
  We never hide our prices, terms and conditions. No hidden fees or taxes. You can see the exact
  price that will not change in the booking process.
* Low deposits
  In international rental companies deposits may reach up to several thousand euros, which will be
  blocked on the client’s bank account. Our average deposit is 300 euros, and we have plenty of car
  rental companies that do not require deposits at all.
* Fair damage assessment
  We assess damage in the presence of a client. Our prices are 2-3 times lower than in international

Rezervasyonlarınızı ve ödemelerinizi her zaman web sitemiz üzerinden yapabilirsiniz.

### Rakipsiz Fiyat Garantisi

**Oscar Rent a Car** olarak, Kıbrıs'ta araç kiralama konusunda en iyi fiyat garantisi sunuyoruz. Her
zaman kaliteli hizmet ve rekabetçi fiyatları bir arada bulacağınızı ve müşteri memnuniyetini en üst
düzeyde tutacağımızı garanti ediyoruz.

Kıbrıs'ta lider araç kiralama firması **Oscar Rent A Cars** olarak, seyahatlerinizi kolaylaştırmak
için **yeni model, konforlu ve uygun fiyatlı araçlar** sunuyoruz. İster **Ercan
Havalimanı’nda** indiğiniz anda, ister **Lefkoşa, Girne veya Gazimağusa’da** olsun, size en uygun
aracı hızlı ve güvenilir bir şekilde teslim ediyoruz. Ekonomik hatchback’lerden lüks SUV’lara kadar
geniş filomuzla, KKTC’deki her türlü ihtiyacınıza cevap veriyoruz.

Oscar Rent a Car, Kuzey Kıbrıs'ta birinci sınıf lüks araç kiralama hizmetleri sunarak, incelik ve
stil arayanlara hitap ediyor. Lüks araçlarımız en üst düzeyde konfor ve kalite sağlayacak şekilde
tasarlanmıştır. Ayrıca filomuzda daha büyük aileler veya gruplar için mükemmel olan 7 kişilik geniş
MPV araçlar bulunmaktadır. Oscar Rent a Car ile Kıbrıs'ı şık bir şekilde keşfetme özgürlüğünü
yaşayın.

KKTC’de **turistik gezileriniz, iş seyahatleriniz veya günlük ulaşım ihtiyaçlarınız** için **Oscar
Rent A Cars** farkını yaşayın. Hemen **Kıbrıs'ta araç kiralamak için online rezervasyon yapın** veya
bizi arayın, size en uygun aracı ayırtalım!

01

###### Araç Yelpazesi

Oscar Rent a Car'ın size aralarından seçim yapabileceğiniz çeşitli seçenekler sunan geniş Kıbrıs

MPV araçlar bulunmaktadır. Oscar Rent a Car ile Kıbrıs'ı şık bir şekilde keşfetme özgürlüğünü
yaşayın.

kiralık araç yelpazesini ve uzman hizmetini keşfedin.

24 saat yol yardım hizmetimiz sayesinde, nerede olursanız olun veya ne zaman ihtiyacınız olursa
olsun, yardımın yalnızca bir telefon uzağınızda olduğunu bilerek güvenle araç kullanabilirsiniz.

03

###### Her Kilometrede Güven ve Kolaylık

müşteri desteğimizle bizi seçtiğinizde sadece araç değil aynı zamanda güven ve kolaylık da
sağlıyoruz.

04

###### Sorunsuz Araç Kiralamada Ortağınız

**Kıbrıs araç kiralama**da kapsamlı deneyimimiz, sektör liderliğimiz ve kaliteli hizmete olan
bağlılığımızla hayatınızı kolaylaştırmak için buradayız.

How do I book a rental car? ][32]

website, or requesting a quote. Once your travel details are confirmed, our team will assist with
vehicle allocation and booking confirmation.

What documents do I need to rent a car? ][33]

A valid government-issued photo ID is required for booking confirmation. For corporate bookings,
company authorization or booking details may also be requested as per policy.

Can I modify or cancel my booking? ][34]

Yes, bookings can be modified or cancelled subject to applicable terms. We recommend informing our

## Car Rental Fuel Policies

**Full to Full**
Your car will have a full tank of fuel upon pick-up. When you return the car, the tank has to be
full.
Make sure you return the car with a full tank to avoid extra fuel charges. If the tank is not
returned full, the supplier will refill the tank at a higher rate than the local petrol stations and
they will charge you extra administration fee.
This fuel policy is normally the preferred choice as it gives least issues at the end of the rental.

**Full to Empty**
When you pick-up your vehicle, you get a car with a full tank of fuel. When you return the car, the
tank does not need to be full. There is no refund for the unused fuel with this policy.
If you don’t want to worry about refueling the car you can get a full to empty policy. This works
best for people who know they will be driving a lot and will use up a full tank.

**Full to Empty with partial refund**
When you pick-up your vehicle, you get a car with a full tank of fuel. When you return the car, the
tank does not need to be full and you will receive a refund on the unused fuel.
The refund will be made when you give back the car, but an administration fee will be charged by the
car hire company.

## Car Rental - Insurance Information

Car rental insurance is confusing, complicated and is the number one question when clients call us..
What kind of insurance do I need? This is the main question we hear from our clientele. In most
cases, you don’t need all the different kinds of rental car insurance that the car rental companies
push you to buy!

**Let’s start by explaining the different type of car rental insurance.**

**What is Collision Damage Waiver (CDW) for a car rental?**
Collision Damage Waiver / Loss Damage Waiver (with excess) limits the customers financial
responsibility for loss or damage of the vehicle up to the excess amounts as long as it is not
caused by driver / renter negligence or part of insurance exclusions. Example: If you take a CDW
insurance with an excess of 700 USD – you will be covered for damage and theft but with a deductible
of 700 USD.

**What is Super Collision Damage Waiver or Supplemental Liability Insurance.**
Super Collision Damage Waiver is an extra insurance to reduce the excess/deductible. This insurance
can be only purchased on arrival directly at the car rental desk. This insurance can be pricey.

**What is Supplemental Liability Insurance?**
Liability insurance for car rental covers damages to other persons car or property as well as for
medical costs for injuries that you are responsible for.

## Car Rental Fuel Policies

**Full to Full**
Your car will have a full tank of fuel upon pick-up. When you return the car, the tank has to be
full.
Make sure you return the car with a full tank to avoid extra fuel charges. If the tank is not
returned full, the supplier will refill the tank at a higher rate than the local petrol stations and
they will charge you extra administration fee.
This fuel policy is normally the preferred choice as it gives least issues at the end of the rental.

**Full to Empty**
When you pick-up your vehicle, you get a car with a full tank of fuel. When you return the car, the
tank does not need to be full. There is no refund for the unused fuel with this policy.
If you don’t want to worry about refueling the car you can get a full to empty policy. This works
best for people who know they will be driving a lot and will use up a full tank.

**Full to Empty with partial refund**
When you pick-up your vehicle, you get a car with a full tank of fuel. When you return the car, the
tank does not need to be full and you will receive a refund on the unused fuel.
The refund will be made when you give back the car, but an administration fee will be charged by the
car hire company.

## Car Rental - Insurance Information

Car rental insurance is confusing, complicated and is the number one question when clients call us..
What kind of insurance do I need? This is the main question we hear from our clientele. In most
cases, you don’t need all the different kinds of rental car insurance that the car rental companies
push you to buy!

**Let’s start by explaining the different type of car rental insurance.**

**What is Collision Damage Waiver (CDW) for a car rental?**
Collision Damage Waiver / Loss Damage Waiver (with excess) limits the customers financial
responsibility for loss or damage of the vehicle up to the excess amounts as long as it is not
caused by driver / renter negligence or part of insurance exclusions. Example: If you take a CDW
insurance with an excess of 700 USD – you will be covered for damage and theft but with a deductible
of 700 USD.

**What is Super Collision Damage Waiver or Supplemental Liability Insurance.**
Super Collision Damage Waiver is an extra insurance to reduce the excess/deductible. This insurance
can be only purchased on arrival directly at the car rental desk. This insurance can be pricey.

**What is Supplemental Liability Insurance?**
Liability insurance for car rental covers damages to other persons car or property as well as for
medical costs for injuries that you are responsible for.

## Frequently asked questions about car rental

[See all questions][9]

### What are the minimum requirements for renting a car?

There are a few different requirements for car rental that depend on the location where you rent. In
the United States or Canada, you must be at least 25 years old, have a valid driver's license for at
least 2 years, and a credit card under your name (selected rental companies also accept debit
cards). If you are traveling to another country, an International Driving Permit (IDP) is required
in some cases.

### How does a car rental security deposit work?

The car rental security deposit, or pre-authorization, is a sum of money held against your credit
card limit for the rental company’s own safety. This isn’t charged as a normal purchase, but only
put on hold for the duration of your reservation. This is done when you pick-up the rental car, and
the full amount is released after drop-off.

### What is included in the car rental rate?

The rental rate at Rentcars typically includes unlimited mileage, basic mandatory protections, and
rental agency administrative fees. Optional items such as child seats or GPS may be available at the
rental counter. Always review your rental agreement carefully to ensure it meets your needs, as some
agencies might have mileage restrictions or optional protections.

### How do the car rental protections work?

Car rental protections cover damage to the vehicle, personal accidents, and liability. Common
protections include LDW (Loss Damage Waiver), CDW (Collision Damage Waiver), ALI (Additional
Liability Insurance), and PAI (Personal Accident Insurance). Coverage names and specifics can vary
by rental company. In case of an incident, file a police report and follow the rental company’s
procedures. Additional protections can be purchased online or at the rental counter.

### What is and how to use a discount code?

Discount codes are promotional offers that reduce your rental rate when applied at checkout. To use
them, enter the code on the payment page during reservation. The fare will update automatically if
the code is valid. Discount codes can be obtained through exclusive promotions, newsletters, or
referral programs. Note that they cannot be combined with cashback offers and cannot be reused if a
reservation is canceled.

### What is a One-Way car rental fee?

The One-Way car rental fee, also known as the Drop-Off Fee, is charged when a vehicle is returned to
a different location than pick-up. This fee covers the cost of taking the car back to its original
location. To check out prices including a One-Way fee, select the "Drop-off at different location"
option.

### How do I compare car rental prices on Rentcars?

To compare the best car rental prices, all you have to do is select your pick-up location (city or
airport, your choice), as well as the pick-up and drop-off date and time. It is also possible to
rent one-way, just select “Drop-off at different location”. After you hit “Search”, Rentcars will
list the best car rental offers, which you can filter by your favorite rental company, desired car
category, price range and more.

### Is it worth renting with Rentcars?

Absolutely! With Rentcars, compare rates from over 350 car rental companies worldwide in one place,
choose the perfect rental op

## Discover Technology Add-ons.
## One Platform 

[Integration Image]

##### Branded booking website

At Rent Centric our latest effort to make your rental business work more smoothly is a series of
specially designed WordPress themes, with our brand new, mobile responsive rental reservation widget
built right in.

[Integration Image]

##### Mobile Agent App

With Mobile Agent app you can perform Checkout and Check-in of vehicle on the go with a tablet. Snap
vehicle inspection pictures, videos, digitally sign rental agreements, automate the input of
drivers’ licenses with barcodes, process credit cards through integrated merchant accounts,
paperless emailing, record keeping and much more.

[Integration Image]

##### Real-time Insurance Verification

Insurance verification allows you to enhance the efficiency of your rental procedures, ensuring that
your renters possess the necessary insurance coverage.

[Integration Image]

##### Real-time License Verification

Rent Centric's real-time driver’s license verification system offers instantaneous verification for
account approval with DMV (AAMVA) check for license suspention. Car rental and car share agencies
can significantly reduce the risk of fraudulent rentals by ensuring that renters have the proper
accreditation to access a rental vehicle.

[Integration Image]

##### Revenue Generating GPS Tracking

Rent Centric’s real-time GPS tracking system allows you to monitor key vehicle metrics—location,
fuel, odometer, sudden braking, acceleration, and status in case of accidents or towing—directly
through Rent Centric software or compatible GPS tracking tools.

[Integration Image]

##### Integrated Toll Processing

Rent Centric toll processing integration helps your car rental operation effectively manage and
streamline your toll processing, leading to improved efficiency, cost savings, and customer
satisfaction.

[Integration Image]

##### Key Management System

Rent Centric’s smart key management enables contactless rentals with instant control to grant or
revoke access. Keys in the Lock Box can be accessed via mobile app or a QR code sent to clients by
email.

[Integration Image]

##### Contactless Technologies

With Rent Centric contactless technologies, you will be able to provide a fully automated and
digital experience for your client. Collect Personal Information, Digital Initials and Signature,
Secure Payment online via Credit Card, Secure Encrypted Interface, Mobile and Desktop Friendly.

[Integration Image]

##### Seamless CRM Connectivity

Rent Centric can provide you with a real-time integration to multiple CRM systems such as Netsuite,
SalesForce, and Zoho. These integrations result in automated actions that expand the functionality
of your Rent Centric software, eliminating the need to toggle back and forth between platforms.

[Integration Image]

##### Reservation API

These websites are seamlessly integrated with the Rent Centric backend system, enabling real-time
reservation delivery. Customers can browse, compare, and book rental cars anytime,
anywhere—eliminating the need to visit or call multiple rental agencies and saving both time and
effort.

[Integration Image]

##### Real-time API Connectivity

Rent Centric API is your ultimate solution for enhancing rental and reservation services. Our API is
designed to offer seamless integration and robust features that will elevate your business
operations.

[Integration Image]

##### Rent Centric Web Hooks

Rent Centric Webhook is an HTTPS post, triggered by an event such as adding a customer or
reservation in Rent Centric system and sent to a your destination system, with a secure API call.
Rent Centric Webhooks are fully automated, in other words they are automatically sent out when any
of the following events happens in Rent Centric.

[Integration Image]

##### Rent Centric SMS Notification

At Rent Centric, we understand the importance of effective communication with your clients. That's
why we offer a comprehensive SMS Notification Service designed specifically for car rental
businesses. Our service ensures that your clients are well-informed at every stage of their rental
journey, enhancing their experience and boosting customer satisfaction.

[Integration Image]

##### Affiliate & Agency Login

A key goal for Rent Centric On-Demand Cloud Computing is to offer our customers every possible
connectivity method, to be close and available where service is needed. Rent Centric allows your
affiliates and business partners such as hotel and motel concierge or local body shop owners with
whom sales relationships have been built to login to a separate portal and manage their rates and
create real-time reservations.

[Integration Image]

##### Paperless Counter

The Rent Centric Paperless Counter app replaces signature pads with a mobile interface, enabling
renters to input data, view agreements, and provide digital signatures and initials. It supports
displaying ads during wait times, emailing digital agreements, and configuring terms with
accept/decline initial lines for compliance.

[Integration Image]

##### Renters Collision Protection

Renter’s Collision Protection, available nationwide, covers all passenger vehicles—including
15-passenger vans, cargo vans, and pickups up to 10,000 lbs. (Coverage for exotic cars is coming
soon.)

distribution platform.

## Corporate Overview

Hertz Global Holdings, Inc. is one of the world’s leading car rental and mobility solutions
providers. Its subsidiaries, including The Hertz Corporation, and licensees operate the Hertz,
Dollar, Thrifty, and Firefly vehicle rental brands, with more than 11,000 rental locations in 160
countries around the globe. The Company also operates the Hertz Car Sales brand, which offers a
range of quality, competitively priced used cars for sale online and at locations across the United
States, and the Hertz 24/7 car-sharing business in Europe. The Company’s operating affiliate, Oro
Mobility, provides integrated driver-led and autonomous fleet management solutions across a range of
mobility segments.

Hertz pioneered the car rental industry, and the Hertz brand is one of the most recognized brands
globally. For more than a century, Hertz has offered innovative, differentiated products to make
every rental experience seamless and special. We believe customers choose Hertz for its wide
selection of top-rated vehicles, for its free Hertz Gold+ loyalty program, and because of Hertz’s
thousands of convenient locations. For more information about Hertz, visit [www.hertz.com][34].
